input.explanation: The whole fault was in this repository. average_spend_per_item_this_month in src/io_shop/spend_summary.py divided by the number of this month's purchases, which is zero for any shopper who hasn't bought this month. The patch returns 0 in that case, so the page renders with the flag on, and no outside service or config needs to change. Once this is deployed, monthly-spend-feature can be turned back on without these account page errors coming back.
